verdict.rationale: Bolna documents a Web Call SDK for browser integration and ships an open-source Python framework (bolna-ai/bolna) plus a CLI and MCP server for building against the platform programmatically, which supports AI-native, agentic workflows. However, there's no evidence of a broader family of official multi-language SDKs (e.g., Node/JS, Python client library beyond the OSS framework) or SDK reference docs/versioning comparable to mature API-first platforms. missing for 10: dedicated multi-language client SDKs, SDK reference/versioning docs, independent corroboration of SDK usage.
